items.item: Recommends a before-save record-triggered flow (or formula field) and says why it beats after-save or Apex
items.evidence: "They're the fastest option because they need no extra DML. They're admin-maintainable and need no test class... Apex would mean introducing that scaffolding for one line of logic."

items.item: Notes that a before-save flow cannot create or update other records
Says to check existing automation on Opportunity first
items.evidence: not found (only notes the repo has no triggers or flows, and does not tell the user to check existing automation)
